annotations.text:
Drawn as the actual phone: 932x430 of display inside the bezel, clipped to the real corner radius, with the Dynamic Island sitting on the left edge in this rotation.

The hatched bands are still the safe area the sides give up. The bottom band is gone — the home indicator strip is now content, in the preview and in the app.

The Device and Safe area sliders above the artboard adjust the corner radii and the gutter width.

Matching what's now live in the app:

• Sets and Days Active are separate pills at the top and bottom of the right edge, so the middle of that edge stays clear.
• Est. time / Focus rides the MONDAY + GYM row.
• Shuffle and both pills clear the physical edge by 6px; nothing reserves space for the home indicator any more.
